offering_description.value: Manufactures precast concrete products for contractors, transportation agencies and building owners. It delivers and installs precast products, rents temporary traffic barriers and licenses product designs to other manufacturers.

primary_products.value: Precast traffic barriers; architectural wall panels; noise barriers; modular concrete buildings; erosion-control blocks

primary_services.value: Temporary traffic barrier rental; precast delivery and installation; product design licensing

customer_segment.value: B2B: General contractors, highway contractors, commercial building owners, utilities and precast concrete manufacturers; B2G: State transportation departments and local public works agencies

end_markets.value: Highway construction and work-zone safety; commercial and institutional construction; utility infrastructure; shoreline protection

revenue_model.value: product sales: Precast concrete barriers, panels, buildings and other site products; rental or leasing: Temporary concrete barriers for roadwork and construction sites; service fees: Delivery and installation of precast products; licensing or royalties: Rights for other precast producers to manufacture and sell proprietary designs
revenue_model.category: product sales; rental or leasing; service fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Casts concrete and steel reinforcement into finished products for contractors, building owners and transportation agencies; service provider: Uses its barrier inventory and crews to supply, install and remove temporary barriers for highway contractors and agencies

geography_served.value: global: Direct operations concentrated in the eastern United States, with international reach through licensees

specialization.value: related lines: Precast traffic barriers, architectural panels, noise walls, modular buildings and erosion-control products

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales and project bids to contractors, building owners, utilities and public agencies; partners / resellers: Licensed precast manufacturers produce and sell the designs in their markets

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Highway barrier crash-test and state transportation specifications, plus plant environmental and OSHA requirements

notes: The current list of countries served by licensees is uncertain.
